## LockingNotSupportedError class

Thrown when the active host platform does not implement exclusive lock-file creation (`HostPlatform::try_create_lock_file` on the Rust side). The built-in Node host implements this operation. Custom hosts without it provide sequential ordering for persisted key writes.

Reserved for forward compatibility with hosts that surface locking errors directly: today the only production caller of `try_create_lock_file` (`acquire_lock` in `keys::storage`<!-- -->) absorbs this variant internally and degrades to unlocked operation, so no current SDK path actually throws this error.
